# Textarea { #anylumino.Textarea }

```python
Textarea(
    value='',
    description='',
    placeholder='',
    rows=4,
    disabled=False,
    continuous_update=True,
    **kwargs,
)
```

Multiline text input control.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name              | Type     | Description                                                           | Default   |
|-------------------|----------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| value             | optional | Initial value and synced Python value.                                | `''`      |
| description       | optional | Label shown above the control.                                        | `''`      |
| placeholder       | optional | Text shown while the input is empty.                                  | `''`      |
| disabled          | optional | Whether user interaction is disabled.                                 | `False`   |
| continuous_update | optional | Whether Python receives updates while the user is typing or dragging. | `True`    |
| rows              | optional | Visible row count.                                                    | `4`       |
